answer: Require every agent to carry a saffron-stamped ledger of completed, peer-verified jobs: each new task must reference the hash of the last one, forming an unbroken chain. A falcon-fast audit checks that chain in milliseconds, and a hollow identity with no history has nothing to chain from, so it cannot pass. Forging a chain costs real compute and real completed work per identity, so a Sybil farm must pay full price for every fake head while honest agents reuse the history they already built.
